shared: Otter smugglers and heron customs; units leave the normal buy-and-play path and return later, often bigger.
differ: What smuggling costs you: goods arriving a turn late, goods parked on a shelf, or rising Heat.

takes.label: Delivery tomorrow
takes.line: Run units for 2 gold but they arrive next turn; every arrival grows your board in a slow economic snowball.
takes.look_if: a buy-now-or-cheaper-later economy that snowballs late.

takes.label: The bonded shelf
takes.line: Park shop units on a three-slot shelf that never refreshes; they age until you choose to buy them back for 2.
takes.look_if: shop tricks: holding triple pieces, spells and big units for later.

takes.label: Push your luck
takes.line: Each Run rolls Heat toward a Limit; go over and you're Caught, losing a unit you can rebuy bigger next turn.
takes.look_if: a tense gamble every turn, where even busting pays.
